small_features.title: Generate video outcome from local Ark Seedance backend
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can open a Video node editor, send prompt/duration plus connected image, reference-video, and audio inputs to the local backend, and receive either a draggable playable Video outcome when Ark returns a URL or visible provider task evidence when Ark returns only an async task id.
scope: Add shared request/response types for Video node generation.
Add FastAPI schemas, Ark provider settings, provider wrapper, and route for local video generation.
Use raw HTTP to Volcengine Ark Seedance `contents/generations/tasks`, not a Python SDK.
Build Ark `content` entries from text prompt, reference images, reference videos, and reference audio.
Add frontend Video node API helper and floating editor.
Seed image_urls, video_urls, and audio_urls from connected image/video/audio outcome nodes when available.
Render a standalone Video outcome node with provider/model evidence, video controls, and one video output port when a URL is available.
Record no-persistence and future task-polling limitations honestly.
acceptance: Video Generate validates prompt/duration and connected media constraints before sending.
Frontend sends only to the local FastAPI backend, never directly to Ark or Seedance.
Backend config errors name missing Ark env keys without leaking secret values.
Provider payloads match the Ark `model`, `content`, `generate_audio`, `ratio`, `duration`, and `watermark` task API shape.
Reference image, reference video, and reference audio URLs map to Ark roles `reference_image`, `reference_video`, and `reference_audio`.
Successful URL responses create or update a single playable Video outcome node; task-id-only responses do not imply playback is ready.
Backend tests, focused web tests, typecheck/build, and rendered interaction verification pass.
